# Bundle

> Free, open source PDF, image, and dev tools that run entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, nothing leaves your device.

Bundle is a client-side web toolkit. Every tool runs 100% in the browser via WebAssembly and Web Workers, no server, no uploads, no accounts, no analytics, no tracking cookies. MIT licensed, source on GitHub: https://github.com/3141roy/personal-toolkit

Any page on this site also serves as clean markdown to a request with `Accept: text/markdown`, instead of full HTML.

## PDF

- [Merge PDF](https://bundle.tools/pdf/merge): combine PDFs into one file, in the order you pick
- [Split PDF](https://bundle.tools/pdf/split): pull pages out of a PDF, by range or one file per page
- [Organize PDF](https://bundle.tools/pdf/organize): reorder, delete, or pull in pages from other PDFs
- [Compress PDF](https://bundle.tools/pdf/pdf-compress): shrink a PDF to a smaller file size
- [Images to PDF](https://bundle.tools/pdf/images-to-pdf): turn photos or scans into one PDF
- [Markdown to PDF](https://bundle.tools/pdf/md-to-pdf): turn a markdown file into a PDF

## Image

- [PDF to Images](https://bundle.tools/image/pdf-to-images): export every page of a PDF as JPG or PNG
- [Resize Image](https://bundle.tools/image/resize): shrink or enlarge an image, in px or %
- [Compress Image](https://bundle.tools/image/compress): shrink an image to a smaller file size
- [Convert Image](https://bundle.tools/image/convert): change an image between PNG, JPEG, and WebP
- [Crop Image](https://bundle.tools/image/crop): trim an image down to a region
- [Round Crop Image](https://bundle.tools/image/round-crop): crop a photo into a circle or square for profile pictures
- [Rotate & Flip Image](https://bundle.tools/image/rotate): turn or mirror an image
- [Image Metadata](https://bundle.tools/image/metadata): see what's hiding in a photo's metadata, and clear it
- [HEIC to JPG](https://bundle.tools/image/heic-to-jpg): turn an iPhone photo into a regular JPG
- [Bulk Image Tools](https://bundle.tools/image/bulk): resize, compress, or convert many images at once

## Dev

- [JSON format](https://bundle.tools/dev/json-format): format, minify, or validate JSON, with a tree view
- [JSON to CSV](https://bundle.tools/dev/json-csv): convert between JSON and CSV, either direction
- [JSON to YAML](https://bundle.tools/dev/json-yaml): convert between JSON and YAML, either direction
- [CSV stats](https://bundle.tools/dev/csv-stats): row and column counts, per-column type, empties, and unique values
- [JSON to types](https://bundle.tools/dev/json-to-types): turn a JSON sample into TypeScript, Zod, JSON Schema, or an OpenAPI schema
- [Timestamp converter](https://bundle.tools/dev/timestamp): a unix timestamp across timezones, with a live countdown

## Text

- [Text diff](https://bundle.tools/text/text-diff): compare two blocks of text, line by line and word by word
- [Word counter](https://bundle.tools/text/text-count): count words, characters, and lines as you type

## About
